definition: mud, dust or grime that makes something unclean
description: A woman in a bright tiled kitchen holds both palms up to the camera, pulling a disgusted face: her hands and fingers are covered in thick dark brown grime. She steps to the white sink, turns on the tap and rubs a bar of purple soap over one filthy palm until white foam builds up. She scrubs the foam between her hands, then rinses both hands under the running water while dark specks wash into the basin. At the end she holds up the bar of soap in one hand and a completely clean pink palm in the other, smiling.

taps.phrase: to pour water into the basin
